arxiv-1809-00241.title: Activity Recognition on a Large Scale in Short Videos - Moments in Time Dataset
arxiv-1809-00241.creator: Ankit Parag Shah*, Harini Kesavamoorthy*, Poorva Rane*, Pramati Kalwad*, Alexander Hauptmann, Florian Metze
arxiv-1809-00241.description: Abstract Moments capture a huge part of our lives. Accurate recognition of these moments is challenging due to the diverse and complex interpretation of the moments. Action recognition refers to the act of classifying the desired action/activity present in a given video.

arxiv-2303-00344.title: Inline Citation Classification using Peripheral Context and Time-evolving Augmentation
arxiv-2303-00344.creator: Priyanshi Gupta 1, Yash Kumar Atri 1, Apurva Nagvenkar 2, Sourish Dasgupta 2, Tanmoy Chakraborty 3
arxiv-2303-00344.description: Abstract Citation plays a pivotal role in determining the associations among research articles. It portrays essential information in indicative, supportive, or contrastive studies. The task of inline citation classification aids in extrapolating these relationships; However, existing studies are still immature and demand further scrutiny.

arxiv-2306-02839.title: Measuring Galaxy Asymmetries in 3D 2020 Measuring Galaxy Asymmetries in 3D – 3D Asymmetries Implementation
arxiv-2306-02839.creator: N. Deg, M. Perron-Cormier, K. Spekkens, M. Glowacki, S.-L. Blyth, N. Hank
arxiv-2306-02839.description: Abstract One of the commonly used non-parametric morphometric statistics for galaxy profiles and images is the asymmetry statistic . With an eye to current and upcoming large neutral hydrogen ( H i ) surveys, we develop a 3D version of the asymmetry statistic that can be applied to datacubes.

arxiv-2405-14379.title: Can Large Language Models Create New Knowledge for Spatial Reasoning Tasks?
arxiv-2405-14379.creator: Thomas Greatrix, Roger Whitaker, Liam Turner, Walter Colombo
arxiv-2405-14379.description: Abstract The potential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate new information offers a potential step change for research and innovation. This is challenging to assert as it can be difficult to determine what an LLM has previously seen during training, making “newness” difficult to substantiate.

arxiv-2408-08230.title: Explaining an Agent’s Future Beliefs through Temporally Decomposing Future Reward Estimators
arxiv-2408-08230.creator: Mark Towers, Yali Du, Christopher Freeman, Timothy J. Norman
arxiv-2408-08230.description: Abstract Future reward estimation is a core component of reinforcement learning agents; i.e., Q-value and state-value functions, predicting an agent’s sum of future rewards. Their scalar output, however, obfuscates when or what individual future rewards an agent may expect to receive.

arxiv-2409-08253.title: The Design of Informative Take-Over Requests for Semi-Autonomous Cyber-Physical Systems: Combining Spoken Language and Visual Icons in a Drone-Controller Setting CCS: Human-centered computing User studies CCS: Human-centered computing Natural language interfaces
arxiv-2409-08253.creator: Ashwini Gundappa, Emilia Ellsiepen, Lukas Schmitz, Frederik Wiehr, Vera Demberg
arxiv-2409-08253.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ashwini Gundappa, Emilia Ellsiepen, Lukas Schmitz, Frederik Wiehr, Vera Demberg. The question of how cyber-physical systems should interact with human partners that can take over control or exert oversight is becoming more pressing, as these systems are deployed for an ever larger range of tasks.

arxiv-2508-21072.title: First-Place Solution to NeurIPS 2024 Invisible Watermark Removal Challenge
arxiv-2508-21072.creator: Fahad Shamshad, Tameem Bakr, Yahia Shaaban, Noor Hussein, Karthik Nandakumar, Nils Lukas
arxiv-2508-21072.description: Abstract Content watermarking is an important tool for the authentication and copyright protection of digital media. However, it is unclear whether existing watermarks are robust against adversarial attacks. We present the winning solution to the NeurIPS 2024 Erasing the Invisible challenge, which stress-tests watermark robustness under varying degrees of adversary knowledge.

arxiv-2512-05075.title: Anisotropic Response in Metamaterials with Elliptically Perforated Plates: Applications to Near-Field Radiative Heat Transfer
arxiv-2512-05075.creator: J. E. Pérez-Rodríguez, R. Esquivel-Sirvent, A. Camacho de la Rosa
arxiv-2512-05075.description: Abstract Metamaterials with tunable optical properties provide a versatile platform for controlling electromagnetic interactions at the nanoscale. This study explores the anisotropic thermal behavior of metamaterials composed of planar plates perforated with periodic arrays of cylinders possessing elliptical cross sections.

britannica-1911-annuity.title: Annuity (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-annuity.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-annuity.description: Article 'Annuity' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. If an annuity is payable for a term of years independent of any contingency, it is called an annuity certain; if it is to continue for ever, it is called a perpetuity; and if in the latter case it is not to commence until after a term of years, it is called a deferred perpetuity.

pmc-11347396.title: TP-Transfiner: high-quality segmentation network for tea pest
pmc-11347396.creator: Ruizhao Wu, Feng He, Ziyang Rong, Zhixue Liang, Wenxing Xu, Fuchuan Ni, Wenyong Dong
pmc-11347396.description: Detecting and controlling tea pests promptly are crucial for safeguarding tea production quality. Due to the insufficient feature extraction ability of traditional CNN-based methods, they face challenges such as inaccuracy and inefficiency of detecting pests in dense and mimicry scenarios.

pmc-11413749.title: Effectiveness of combinations of active compression-decompression cardiopulmonary resuscitation, impedance threshold devices and head-up cardiopulmonary resuscitation in adult out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: A systematic review
pmc-11413749.creator: Shona E. Main, David B. Sidebottom, Charles D. Deakin, James Raitt, Helen Pocock, Julian Hannah, James O.M. Plumb
pmc-11413749.description: ObjectiveThis review summarises the current evidence base for combinations of neuroprotective CPR adjuncts (active compression-decompression chest compressions, impedance threshold devices, and head-up positioning) during out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.MethodsA systematic search (PROSPERO registration CRD42023432302) was performed in English on MEDLINE, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library in August 2023, and repeated in February 2024.

pmc-11677477.title: Towards Reliable Methodology: Microbiome Analysis of Fresh Frozen vs. Formalin-Fixed Paraffin-Embedded Bladder Tissue Samples: A Feasibility Study
pmc-11677477.creator: Dominik Enderlin, Uwe Bieri, Jana Gadient, Yasser Morsy, Michael Scharl, Jan Hendrik Rüschoff, Lukas John Hefermehl, Anna Nikitin, Janine Langenauer, Daniel Stephan Engeler, Beat Förster, Fabian Obrecht, Jonathan Surber, Thomas Paul Scherer, Daniel Eberli, Cédric Poyet
pmc-11677477.description: Studies have shown that the human microbiome influences the response to systemic immunotherapy. However, only scarce data exist on the impact of the urinary microbiome on the response rates of bladder cancer (BC) to local Bacillus Calmette-Guérin instillation therapy. We launched the prospective SILENT-EMPIRE study in 2022 to address this question.

pmc-12460928.title: Change points in Australian suicide rates: Trends from 2000 to 2022
pmc-12460928.creator: Leo Roberts, Angela Clapperton, Matthew J Spittal
pmc-12460928.description: Objective:There is concern that suicides in Australia have been increasing, especially among young women. Our aim was to describe the long-term trends in suicide rates, identifying any change points among all suicides and among age-sex population groups.Method:We extracted annual Australian suicide data from 2000 to 2022 from the General Record of Incidence of Mortality.

pmc-12644999.title: RB loss sensitizes triple-negative breast cancer to apoptosis induced by cellular stress
pmc-12644999.creator: Agnieszka K Witkiewicz, Subrahmanya Anirudh Kaligotla Venkata, Erik S Knudsen, Vishnu Kumarasamy
pmc-12644999.description: Functional loss of RB1 is a common genetic alteration in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and is associated with poor response to targeted therapies, including CDK4/6 inhibitors. In this study, we perform an unbiased drug screen and identify that co-targeting distinct cell cycle processes such as DNA repair and mitosis induce synthetic lethality selectively in RB-deficient models.

pmc-13539876.title: An unusual presentation of membranous nephropathy with primary and secondary features: a case report
pmc-13539876.creator: Aanya Shah, Stephen Baker, Dar B Shah
pmc-13539876.description: Membranous nephropathy (MN) is a common cause of nephrotic syndrome in adults, broadly classified as primary or secondary based on etiology and pathologic findings. We present a single unusual case report of a 75-year-old woman with an 11-year course of MN featuring concurrent characteristics of both primary and secondary disease.

uslaw-usc-t10-s3222.title: 10 U.S.C. § 3222 — Independent cost estimate required before approval
uslaw-usc-t10-s3222.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s3222.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part V (Acquisition); Subpart B (Acquisition Planning); Chapter 222 (Independent Cost Estimation And Cost Analysis). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Requirement.— A milestone decision authority may not approve entering the engineering and manufacturing development phase, or production and deployment phase, of a major defense acquisition program or major subprogram unless an independent cost estimate.
